name: Quiver
notes: PLACEHOLDER. Quiver manages its own library of native recompilation builds rather than matching ROM files by extension. integration_mode 'library_adapter' means our adapter should read Quiver's own game list/config and surface those entries, delegating the actual launch to Quiver (or the recomp binary it points at) rather than building launch args from a bare ROM path. repo/paths/CLI not yet confirmed against a real Quiver install.
